simple.summary: שָׁבִיס (shâbîyç) means a netting for the hair First listed occurrence: Isa 3 18.

definitions.full: H7636. shabis שָׁבִיס noun [masculine] front-band (Mishna id.; Levy NHWB iv. 498 ; al. compare Arabic , literally a sun , of small glass neck-ornament We Skizzen iii. 145 ; Hebrew perhaps a diminutive, see Ges § 86 note); — plural הַשְּׁבִיסִים Isa 3:18 , in list of women's finery.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to interweave ;
